BiblicalUsage: Adah bare Jabal, and he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle. The tent and the herd begin with him, before the flood ever comes.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jabal is the father of a way of life: the first tent-dweller and herdsman, born before the flood, and the nomad's life that Abraham will one day live begins with him.
